map.deniedGuide: Usually a past denial or location turned off system-wide. Check in order: 1) OS master switch: iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services on; Android Settings → Location on. 2) Browser site permission: Chrome lock icon → Location → Allow. 3) Opened inside WeChat/IG? Reopen this link in Safari/Chrome.

terms.title: Three modes, which one?
terms.lede: One app, three visibility levels, switchable anytime. Check who can see you before switching.
terms.publicDesc: Everyone sees your check-ins and green dot; you can cheers, invite, and like anyone.
terms.publicRisk: Risk: block-level location and photos are visible to strangers. Stay safe out there.
terms.friendsDesc: Only mutual friends see your check-ins and green dot; interactions are friends-only.
terms.friendsRisk: Risk: friends can screenshot and forward. Don't add strangers lightly.
terms.stealthDesc: You see others' public content, but can't check in, cheers, invite, or like. No heartbeat, no green dot — nobody sees you.
terms.stealthRisk: Risk: public content posted before going stealth stays public. Stealth is not deletion.
terms.crossBorder: AI analysis runs on overseas cloud services; your photos and text may be transferred abroad for processing.
terms.ageNote: Drinking content is for adults aged 18 and above only.
